5617397.name: Bais Betzalel Chabad of Rancho Bernardo-Poway
5617397.note: San Diego Jewish World, Nov 10 2022 (Donald H. Harrison, 'Doctor Who Became a Rabbi Runs Chabad Shul in Rancho Bernardo'): the Trestmans chose to sever their ties to Chabad of Poway 'after Rabbi Yisroel Goldstein was convicted' (2020); 'Because people were wary of meeting indoors during the COVID-19 pandemic, they decided to establish at the side of their home a prayer tent where a daily minyan could be held outside. At that time, they named their congregation Bais Betzalel ... because they were not yet formally affiliated with Chabad. Since that time, Rabbi Yonah Fradkin ... and Rabbi Baruch Shlomo Cunin ... have designated Trestman as the North County Inland shaliach'. So it began between 2020 and 2022 (the listing's id dates from about 2022, though chabad.org published it later). Its chabad.org listing went up on Nov 22 2024 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then.

earlier.where: a prayer tent at the side of the Trestmans' home in Rancho Bernardo (then the remodeled home itself; Shabbat services at a rented facility)
